test_title: PYST 2: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Q sits to the immediate left of S. Only three people sit between R and T. P sits to the immediate left of T. Who sits in the middle of the row?
solution:
**Given : Five people P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north. **

**Explanation :**

1) Only three people sit between R and T. 

2) P sits to the immediate left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75ca9b5ea869c75d5af4bf90355b83886677d189c52dfc966817a722eb1b95a2.png] 

3) Q sits to the immediate left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/692ac1fd60fe8ecce02f4b2d2ff149104f9c8c8f6ad28fa9c166362eebaaf852.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement S sits in the middle of the row.

Hence, **"S"** is the correct answer.
